Draft/Notes

Subject: On-call moving to two-week shifts — starting the 15th

Team — starting the 15th we’re switching on-call to two-week (14-day) rotations instead of one-week. The goal is improved continuity, fewer handoffs, and better incident ownership. Your on-call responsibilities themselves don’t change; only the rotation length does. The updated schedule will be posted before the 15th. If you need to swap a shift, follow the existing swap process or coordinate with your manager/team lead. Questions or concerns — reply here or DM me.

Thanks,
[Your name]
